- Option B: Tue, 2027-08-30 — 09:00–10:00 PT (backup, earlier cadence)

Suggested EB attendee list (Redwood): CEO / Head of Product (overview), Solutions Engineer (Marcus — deep tech), Customer Success lead (Marissa)
Suggested EB attendee list (Acme): CEO/CTO sponsor, VP Eng (Carlos), Procurement rep

1) Confirm which EB slot you prefer and final names for the Acme execs.
2) We will convert the draft MAP to a shared worksheet with owner columns and due dates; Marcus will own technical milestones.
3) Laura will draft a short SOW skeleton and share a DocuSign link when you confirm scope.
